# who

Verify connection and show current user info from Dataverse

## Usage

```
ppds env who [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Environment to query (ID, URL, unique name, or partial name). Uses profile default if not specified. |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
